gaps.explanation: Proprietary statement p7 prints under Interfund transfers the row 'Transfers to other funds': Water Fund 39,211, Sewer Fund 39,211, Solid Waste Fund (9,865), Total 68,557. Added 39,211 + 39,211 - 9,865 = 68,557 = business_type transfers_net; gap 0.
